slug: 2024-01-01 Lesotho National Digital Transformation Strategy - Agenda 2030

facts.fact: The 2024 strategy cites the absence of an overarching digital government architecture, gaps in interoperability, and says a digital government interoperability framework should be defined and implemented, listing it as a very high priority action led by MICSTI; no framework is reported as existing or in drafting.

systems.tiers: ministries, departments, agencies and district government offices
